content.text: Kânging hoeh e yawcu teh BAWIPA hanelah panuet a tho teh,
kânging e bangnuenae teh a ngai e lah ao.
Kâoup navah yeiraiponae ao teh,
kârahnoum navah lungangnae ao.
Tamikalan teh yuemkamcunae ni a hrawi han,
hatei, yuemkamcu hoeh e khopouknae niteh
amamouh a raphoe han.
Lungkhueknae tueng navah hnopai teh cungkeihoeh,
hatei lannae ni teh duenae koehoi a rungngang han.
Lannae ni teh toun kaawm hoeh e naw hah lam kalan a pâtue han,
hatei, tamikathoutnaw teh
thoenae dawk letlang a rawp awh han.
Tamikalannaw teh lannae ni a rungngang awh han,
hatei, yuemkamcu hoeh e naw teh
amamae ngainae dawk a kâman awh han.
Tamikathoutnaw a due awh toteh
a ngaihawi awh e puenghai a kahma vaiteh,
tamikalanhoehnaw e ngaihawinae puenghai a kahma han.
Tamikalan teh runae thung hoi a hlout vaiteh,
hote runae teh tamikathoutnaw ni a pang awh han.
Cathut ka taket hoeh e niteh, a pahni hoi a imri ouk a raphoe,
hatei, tamikalan teh thoumthainae lahoi rungngang lah ao han.
Tamikalan ni hawinae a coe navah khobuem a konawm awh,
hatei, tamikathout a due toteh a lunghawi awh.
Tamikalan ni yawhawi a coe navah khopui hai tawmrasang lah a o,
hatei, tamikathoutnaw e pahni ni teh ouk a raphoe.
Lungangnae ka vout e tami ni teh a imri hah ouk a dudam,
hatei, thaipanueknae ka tawn e teh duem ao.
Yuengyoe ka pai ni teh lawk kapap e tami ni hrolawk hah
ouk a pâpho, hatei, yuemkamcu e ni teh ouk a hro.
Pouknae kahawi poenae a ohoehnae koe
khocanaw ouk a kahma teh,
pouknae kahawi poenae apapnae koe teh
khocanaw roumnae a coe awh.
Panue hoeh e tami panuesaknae teh a khang han, hatei,
lawkpanuesaknae dawk kut tambeinae
ka ngai hoeh e teh a hlout han.
Pahrennae ka tawn e napui ni barinae a coe,
hatei, a thakasai e tongpa ni teh tawntanae a coe.
Pahrennae ka tawn e tami ni a hringnae han lah hnokahawi a sak,
hatei, tamikathout teh
a takthai hanelah runae kapoekung doeh.
Tamikathout ni dumnae phu ouk a hmu awh,
hatei, lannae cati katukkungnaw ni tawkphu katang teh
a coe awh han.
Lannae ni hringnae lamthung dawk tami a hrawi e patetlah,
thoenae ka sak e ni ouk a duekhai.
Lungthin ka longkawi e teh BAWIPA hanelah panuet a tho,
hatei, tamikalan kakuepcingnaw e hringnae teh
amamouh letlang lunghawinae doeh.
Lungkânging lah ao awh nakunghai,
tamikathout teh rek laipalah awm mahoeh.
Hatei, tamikalannaw e canaw teh hloutsak lah ao han.
A meihawi eiteh pouknae ka tawn hoeh e napui teh,
vok hnawng dawk suikuthrawt bang pouh e patetlah doeh ao.
Tamikalan ni ngainae teh hawinae dueng doeh,
hatei, tamikathout ni a ring e teh lungkhueknae dueng doeh.
Thouk ka poe e teh, thouk a tawnta,
hatei moikapap a pâkhueng eiteh, ka mathoe e tami hai ao.
Hring ka pasoung e teh tawnta sak lah ao han.
Ayâ tui ka awi e teh ama hai tui awi lah ao han.
Cakang ka haw e tami teh ayâ ni thoe a bo han.
hatei, kayawtkung koe teh yawhawinae ao han.
Hawinae ka tawng katang e ni barinae a coe han.
hatei, thoenae ka tawng koe teh runae a pha han.
Hnopai kâuep e teh a rawp han,
hatei tamikalan teh phokung patetlah dikhring han.
Ma e imthung runae ka poe e ni a coe e râw teh kahlî lah ao vaiteh,
tamipathu teh a lungkaangnaw koe san lah ao han.
Tamikalannaw e a paw teh hringnae thing paw lah ao teh,
muitha ka man e teh tami a lungkaang e doeh.
Tamikalan patenghai talai van reknae khang pawiteh,
cathutlaipa e hoi tamikayon teh
banghloimaw hoe a khang han vai.
